description: This file is a PHP source code for managing a web interface page that allows adding allowed devices to a parental control or device management system. It includes server-side PHP code interleaved with HTML and JavaScript, handling form rendering, device list generation, and client-side validation and interactions.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Fetches configuration or system string values, such as feature toggles or branding links.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values for device hosts, used to populate the list of current devices.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Retrieves instance identifiers for device host entries.
